voice-clone.en: Clone your own voice locally on a Mac (Apple Silicon) with CosyVoice3 and generate Chinese / mixed Chinese-English narration.
voice-clone.zh: 在 Mac 本地复刻你自己的声音，生成中文（及中英混合）配音。

code-cinema.en: Direct and render artistic music videos / short films in code (Canvas + WebGL + headless Chrome + ffmpeg); picks or invents a visual style from the content.
code-cinema.zh: 用代码导演并渲染有艺术性的 MV 与短片，按内容选择或原创画面风格。
